global_invariants: Every workflow authorizes before query/projection and reauthorizes before target traversal or authoritative mutation.
Definition, placement, and live-instance identities are separate and remain visible where context requires more than one layer.
Reference inspection, comparison, filtering, preview, recommendation, and provisional selection are non-authoritative.
A source Definition is never silently rewritten by Campaign placement, live runtime state, GM notes, encounter assumptions, loot state, relationships, or playable conversion.
Hidden existence, counts, labels, variants, relationships, provenance, loot, waves, tactics, motives, and diagnostics are removed before unauthorized serialization.
Source facts, source absence, conflicts, inference, and owner-delegated recommendation status remain distinguishable.
AI and service actors receive the minimum operation-specific projection and remain proposal/read-only unless a separate owning workflow explicitly grants a governed mutation action.
Offline/recovery state never upgrades authority or turns cached hidden data into permitted data.

workflows.name: Library / Inspector reference flow
preconditions: apply role-safe projection before result/facet/count construction
steps: search/filter or resolve exact stable ID
open summary projection
select presentation profile from governed metadata/context
inspect permitted sections
traverse only authorized linked abilities/items/relationships/variants/source evidence
optionally compare permitted source/version/variant targets
optionally hand off a provisional selection to an owning Picker/authoring workflow
workflows.mutation_owner: none; any mutation requires explicit handoff to the owning workflow
privacy_requirements: hidden records contribute no suggestions, labels, facets, counts, relationships, variants, compare targets, or provenance hints
recovery_requirements: history/cache restores navigation only; current authority is re-evaluated before object delivery

workflows.name: GM NPC & Creature Manager authoring flow
surface_refs: UI Design Bible GM Core — NPC & Creature Manager
preconditions: determine source Definition versus Campaign-local draft
steps: search or choose source Definition, template, variant, or Campaign-local draft
inspect immutable source/reference layer
create or edit Campaign-local persona/notes/relationships/equipment/behavior references only within granted scope
link governed Ability/Item/Relationship/Faction objects by stable reference rather than copying source mechanics
mark GM-private/revealable/player-visible fields explicitly
validate missing source, conflicts, recommendations, permissions, references, and local overrides
save through Campaign/content owning workflow with provenance receipt
workflows.authoritative_mutation_performed: only for authorized Campaign-local authoring data after explicit save/commit
forbidden_mutations: published Definition without its own governed publication/versioning workflow
privacy_requirements: GM-private motives, notes, hidden inventory, hidden relationships, reveal conditions, and encounter tactics retain explicit visibility metadata and never enter Player projection early
recovery_requirements: autosave/draft recovery preserves source/local distinction and revalidates target permissions before publish/use

workflows.name: Scene quick-add / placement flow
preconditions: ensure selected object is valid for Scene placement
steps: open constrained Picker or use provisional Inspector selection
revalidate selection against current authority
set local label if permitted
set quantity without changing source identity
set visibility/reveal policy
set encounter role/wave/starting assumptions where applicable
set permitted local overrides with explicit provenance
create distinct placementId
persist through Scene/Campaign workflow
identity_invariants: placement state does not alter Definition
multiple placements may reference one Definition
privacy_requirements: hidden placement existence/count/wave/local label/tactics do not enter unauthorized search, scene, encounter, or runtime projections
recovery_requirements: recovered draft reauthorizes source and Scene before commit; orphaned/missing source becomes explicit validation issue rather than silent substitution

workflows.name: Encounter preparation and balance-analysis flow
preconditions: resolve exact source/version/pack and current placement assumptions
steps: add authorized participant/placement
set encounter role, quantity, wave, start state, and visible/hidden assumptions
normalize required analysis fields with provenance from source/linked objects
record missing/inferred/recommended values and confidence instead of fabricating certainty
analyze party/participant pressure using current advisory methodology
surface warnings, assumptions, uncertainty, and hidden-information boundaries
save draft/template or freeze launch-ready encounter snapshot
workflows.authoritative_mutation_performed: Encounter draft/snapshot mutation only; source Definitions remain immutable
privacy_requirements: Player/Observer never receive hidden participants, counts, waves, tactics, secret objectives, GM-only warnings, or analysis of hidden state
recovery_requirements: reopen draft with stale-source warnings and revalidate before analysis/launch; no silent upgrade to newer variant/version
accessibility_requirements: table/list alternative to visual encounter composition

workflows.name: Live runtime creature/NPC flow
preconditions: instanceId and placementId bound to launch snapshot
steps: inspect current role-safe instance summary
open linked action/ability/rule without leaving runtime context
choose/propose authorized action and target
validate current resources/conditions/targeting and Session authority
submit through governed action/approval pipeline
apply authoritative event result to live instance only
append timeline/log/provenance
reproject role-safe state
privacy_requirements: unrevealed participants/resources/forms/conditions/tactics remain server-side; role projections recomputed after every authority-sensitive event
recovery_requirements: reconnect restores current authoritative instance state by stable session/instance identity; local cache cannot fabricate Events or permissions

workflows.name: Investigation / social NPC flow
preconditions: compute revealed statements/relationships/reputation separately from GM truth
steps: inspect role-safe identity/persona
view only revealed statements, contradictions, reliability cues, relationships, reputation, and faction context
open related evidence/timeline through owning investigation permissions
perform social/investigation action through owning workflow
GM may reveal or change Campaign-local social truth only through governed social/investigation controls
refresh persona projection after approved reveal/outcome
workflows.authoritative_mutation_performed: only by owning governed social/investigation action
privacy_requirements: secret motives, hidden relationships, unrevealed faction ties, GM reliability assessments, and hidden statements are absent from Player payloads
workflows.uncertainty_rule: Player-facing uncertainty may be represented without exposing whether GM truth exists or what it is
recovery_requirements: timeline/profile restore recomputes visibility from current Campaign authority and reveal history

workflows.name: Exploration / bestiary / discovery flow
steps: open known creature/bestiary entry
show authorized ecology/habitat/behavior/environment interactions
distinguish observed Campaign knowledge from full source/GM truth
link sightings/discoveries/timeline entries without mutating source ecology
GM reveal/update discovery state through owning exploration workflow
refresh role-safe bestiary projection
workflows.authoritative_mutation_performed: discovery/reveal history only through owning workflow
privacy_requirements: undiscovered creatures/locations/weaknesses/habitats can be withheld without leaking counts, facets, labels, or source coordinates
recovery_requirements: offline journal may show previously authorized cached knowledge but does not reveal new source data; sync reauthorizes before new discoveries are projected

workflows.name: Variant / template / stage comparison flow
steps: select permitted sibling/stage/template/type-modifier candidate
reauthorize both sides before diff
normalize comparable field groups without replacing absent fields
show changed/added/removed/unknown/conflicted values textually
show source/provenance differences
optionally hand a selected variant to a Picker/authoring workflow
identity_requirements: same display name is not identity
modifier relationship may apply to a base without creating a merged replacement object
privacy_requirements: hidden variants/stages/forms contribute no compare labels/counts or missing-slot hints
recovery_requirements: deep-linked compare reauthorizes both candidates and fails safely if either target is no longer permitted

workflows.name: Summon / minion / spawn flow
preconditions: determine whether result is placement, runtime spawn, or both
steps: inspect summon relationship and limits
validate resource/capacity/control prerequisites
create distinct placement and/or live instance through owning workflow
bind controller/summoner/master relationships explicitly
track duration, dismissal, destruction, release, or control-break lifecycle
apply runtime events to instance only
archive/close lifecycle while preserving source Definition
identity_requirements: summoner != controller != owner != source creator unless explicitly identical by governed data
spawn/instance IDs remain distinct from Definition
privacy_requirements: hidden spawn conditions, reserve counts, secret masters, and control-break conditions remain absent from unauthorized projections
recovery_requirements: reconnect restores authoritative lifecycle/control state; expired/dismissed instances do not reappear from stale cache

workflows.name: Playable creature conversion handoff
steps: inspect source creature and conversion rule
select governed base version
classify retained physical traits
classify excluded monster-runtime state
calculate/source-reference base XP rule where applicable
identify unlockable/tierable abilities by stable reference
apply Character normalization rules in target draft workflow
validate resulting Character/species draft
record conversion provenance linking source, rules, retained/normalized/excluded fields
workflows.authoritative_mutation_performed: Character draft/progression mutation only through owning workflow
identity_requirements: source creature != playable species definition != Character instance
monster HP/conditions/runtime state are not copied as Character current state
privacy_requirements: only authorized source traits and conversion options are presented; hidden GM source variants do not become Player choices
recovery_requirements: saved conversion draft retains source/version provenance and revalidates source/rules before publish/commit

cross_workflow_handoffs.contract: provisional selection only; Scene workflow revalidates before placement
source/reference handoff only; Character workflow owns conversion mutation
Campaign-local authoring result may be selected for placement after validation and authority check
Encounter preparation consumes placement/source refs and may add analysis assumptions without mutating source
launch freezes authorized participant snapshot and creates runtime instances; runtime does not mutate Encounter source assumptions retroactively
social/investigation persona context may coexist with runtime combat instance without identity collapse
known-bestiary projection may open authorized reference Inspector; source diagnostics remain separately permissioned
chosen variant remains provisional until Scene Picker revalidation
spawned live instance enters authoritative Session lifecycle with distinct instance ID

stop_conditions: A workflow requires changing canonical authorization semantics rather than consuming current authority contracts.
A required Creature/NPC behavior cannot be represented without inventing a new canonical object identity/type or merging source identities.
A source/provenance conflict cannot be preserved without selecting an unsupported winner.
A workflow would require sending GM-private/hidden data to an unauthorized client before reveal.
A design decision requires implementation/runtime/deployment authority outside PPIA-02.
